The largest condo complex in Hawthorne: a listing headline on the building-directory site records it as a 134-unit, wood-frame development, and unit listings record build years of 1990 and 1991 for different parts of the complex — treat the exact year per building as not confirmed until the strata plan is read. The same listing records pets allowed.

A low-rise condo building recorded in listings as built in 1987; a top-floor listing describes it as rain screened and states "Pets welcome". Unit count: Not confirmed — no source checked publishes it. Construction type: Not confirmed.

The newest apartment building in the sub-area, recorded in listings as built in 2016, with a large rooftop patio/garden area and a bike room in the garage; one top-floor listing records two parking stalls with the unit. Unit count and construction type: Not confirmed.

items.t: Hawthorne is the north-Ladner pocket built around Hawthorne Elementary, 5160 Central Avenue, and Hawthorne Park, 5151 56 Street.

Central Avenue, 57 Street and Ladner Trunk Road (Highway 10) are the roads named on TransLink's route 618 loop through Hawthorne; route 618 runs from Ladner Exchange via Harvest Drive, Ladner Trunk Road, Central Avenue, Linden Drive, Westminster Avenue and Ferry Road.

Where the condo stock actually concentrates: the 53 Street corridor west of Central Avenue — Ladner Pointe and Green Gables sit on the same few blocks of 53 Street — plus The Pointe on 55B Street and Keira Gardens on Linden Drive. This is Ladner's main low-rise condo corridor, a short drive or bus ride from Ladner Exchange, where route 601 runs to Bridgeport Station (Canada Line).

Ladner Leisure Centre, 4600 Clarence Taylor Crescent, and Ladner Pioneer Library, 4683 51st Street, are the recreation and library anchors for the area; Delta Hospital, 5800 Mountain View Blvd, sits beside Ladner Exchange.

The newest condo building here is already a decade old. The Pointe (2016) is the most recent apartment building verified in Hawthorne; the rest of the apartment stock is 1987–1991 wood frame. New supply in and around the sub-area is arriving as townhouses (Wildwood Ladner) and as the village-core presale in the Ladner Elementary sub-area, not as new Hawthorne apartment buildings.

The 2024 OCP removed the old area-plan structure. Older City documents refer to a Ladner Area Plan as Schedule B.3 of the former OCP, Bylaw No. 3950; the consolidated OCP, Bylaw No. 8400 (2024), has no lettered schedules — future change in Hawthorne is governed by the single Land Use Plan.

SSMUH changed the detached streets in 2024. Delta's June 24, 2024 SSMUH adoption (Bylaws 8394 and 8395) lets many detached lots around the condo corridor add suites, duplex units, coach houses and garden suites without a rezoning.
There is no Hawthorne market data in the standard stats pack.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect townhome buyers in Hawthorne

items.t: Form B first (all counted stock here is strata): Under s. 59 of the Strata Property Act, the Form B Information Certificate discloses the unit's monthly strata fees, amounts the owner owes, approved-but-unpaid special levies, the contingency reserve fund (CRF) balance, parking and storage allocations, and a summary of the strata's insurance; the strata must provide it within 7 days of a request, and the rules, current budget and most recent depreciation report must be attached.

: A fee-simple townhouse carries NO strata, NO Form B and NO strata fees; municipal rules plus any registered covenants or homeowners' association govern instead. No verified fee-simple townhouse complex exists in Hawthorne, so that frame does not apply to any counted complex here — if a listing calls a Hawthorne townhouse "fee simple," get the title, because it contradicts the verified record. (Complex entries in above.)

Delta zoning number: CONTESTED — flagged, not asserted: Zoning is in any case assigned parcel by parcel — e.g., Keira Gardens' listing records zoning CD376, a site-specific comprehensive development zone — so read the specific complex's zone off the City's zoning maps, not off a bylaw number quoted in marketing.

GST on new construction only: Resale townhouses carry no GST. On a new home (Wildwood), the first-time home buyers' GST/HST rebate (Bill C-4, Royal Assent March 13, 2026, per CRA) rebates 100% of the GST up to $1 million (maximum $50,000), phasing out to $1.5 million, for agreements on or after March 20, 2025 and before 2031; the older GST New Housing Rebate is 36% of the GST, maximum $6,300, phasing out between $350,000 and $450,000.

Down-payment programs: The Home Buyers' Plan allows up to $60,000 per person withdrawn from RRSPs for a first home, and the First Home Savings Account allows $8,000 per year to a $40,000 lifetime limit; the two can be combined for the same home.

Hawthorne's townhouse supply is one street deep. All three completed complexes and the one presale sit on or just off Central Avenue (4910, 4887 and 4900 Central Avenue, plus Keira Gardens on Linden Drive) — a buyer searching the whole sub-area is really searching one corridor.

The newest townhouse product is also the only presale. Wildwood Ladner's 40 homes are larger than the three completed complexes combined on verified counts (10 + 24, with Central Park uncounted) — when it completes, it redraws this sub-area's townhouse supply in one step.

SSMUH changed the detached streets in 2024, not the strata corridor. Delta's June 24, 2024 SSMUH adoption (Bylaws 8394 and 8395) lets many detached lots around the townhouse complexes add suites, duplexes, coach houses and garden suites without a rezoning — the competition for a townhouse buyer's dollar here increasingly includes a house with a suite.

blocks.text: Local rules that affect land buyers in Hawthorne

items.t: Streamside rule: All properties in Delta within 30 m of a stream, including sloughs and ditches, fall within the Streamside Protection and Enhancement Development Permit Area, which can limit building and subdivision work on the lot.

Dyke / flood diligence: Ladner is low land protected by the City's dike, seawall and drainage system (over 63 km of flood protection infrastructure, 31 drainage pump stations, ~538 km of drainage infrastructure). Confirm flood construction requirements for the specific lot with the City.

: ALR residences cannot be stratified — strata plans cause subdivision in the ALR (ALC Information Bulletin 09, s. 6; Strata Property Act, s. 239; Agricultural Land Commission Act, s. 21(1)) — and subdivision within the ALR requires ALC approval, as the ALC states it. ALC residence caps: principal residence 500 m² or less total floor area; a secondary suite only within the principal residence; one additional residence of 90 m² or less (parcels 40 ha or less) or 186 m² or less (parcels over 40 ha).

GST on vacant land: CRA's position, stated only at the level its publication supports: most sales of vacant land by individuals are exempt (for example, land kept for personal use), but a sale is taxable where the land was subdivided into more than two parts, and sales by developers/businesses are generally taxable supplies. A resale house lot in Hawthorne will usually sit on the exempt side; a newly subdivided lot sold by a developer usually will not — the specific sale's treatment is a facts question, finer points not confirmed.

GST on the new housing that replaces land here: New homes (Wildwood presale homes, a new build on a Hawthorne lot) carry GST; resales do not. The first-time home buyers' GST rebate (Bill C-4, Royal Assent March 13, 2026, per CRA News No. 122) rebates 100% of the GST on new HOUSING up to $1 million (maximum $50,000), phasing out to $1.5 million, agreements March 20, 2025–2031 — it applies to new housing, NOT to bare land itself. The older GST New Housing Rebate is 36% of the GST, maximum $6,300, phasing out between $350,000 and $450,000.

Presales (REDMA) — the Wildwood frame: Where a presale exists, the developer must deliver a disclosure statement; s. 21 gives the buyer 7 days from the later of signing or acknowledging that statement to rescind, and deposits are held in trust. That is the protection set on the Wildwood homes — it does not create any lot offering.

Federal non-Canadian purchase prohibition — the land point: CMHC states the prohibition (to January 1, 2027, in census metropolitan areas including Metro Vancouver) covers buildings of three or fewer dwelling units, and that effective March 27, 2023 it does NOT apply to vacant land — vacant land zoned for residential and mixed use can be purchased by non-Canadians and used for any purpose, including residential development.

Strata block — background for any strata lot a Hawthorne search spills into: Form B (SPA s. 59) within 7 days of request, disclosing fees, levies, CRF balance and insurance summary; depreciation reports every five years for stratas with five or more lots since July 1, 2024; minimum 10% CRF contribution since November 1, 2023; rental-restriction bylaws VOID since November 24, 2022; only 55+ age bylaws valid (SPA ss. 123.1/123.2, May 1, 2023 exemptions).
Hawthorne's growth is one street deep.

The spelling lock bites at Hawthorne's north edge. The AREA to the north is "Neilsen Grove"; its SCHOOL is "Neilson Grove Elementary". A page or listing that uses one spelling for both is wrong on one of them — and the error is in MLS feed text as often as in page copy.

items.t: Zoning, SSMUH and suites (Delta): Delta's SSMUH zoning amendments (Bylaws 8394 + 8395) allow combinations of single detached dwellings, duplex dwellings, secondary suites, coach houses and garden suites where the zoning applies — a duplex is the baseline two-unit form, and SSMUH does not by itself split a duplex into separately titled halves. The RS1 zone lists a secondary suite as an accessory use to a single detached dwelling.

Flood and streamside (Delta): The City of Delta operates and maintains over 63 kilometres of flood protection infrastructure (dikes, seawalls and foreshore protection), 31 drainage pump stations and approximately 538 kilometres of drainage infrastructure. All properties in Delta within 30 m of a stream, including sloughs and ditches, fall within the Streamside Protection and Enhancement Development Permit Area — check that setback before planning additions or a coach house on a duplex lot.

5625 Ladner Trunk Road currently holds townhouses, which would be demolished for the approved rental apartment.

Council adopted Delta's small-scale multi-unit housing (Bill 44) zoning on June 24, 2024; houseplexes of three or four units become a permitted use, and secondary suites are not allowed inside a houseplex.
Delta's announcement states a minimum of four units on lots over 280 m² and six units within 400 m of frequent transit.
The Province defines frequent transit as a route every 15 minutes on average, weekdays 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. and weekends 10 a.m. to 6 p.m.
Delta's current limits: 9.5 m sloped-roof height, 1.5 m side yard, one on-site space per unit; proposed changes are 10.5 m height, 40% coverage and 15 m frontage for new lots.
Strata corporations cannot pass rental-restriction bylaws, but can restrict or ban short-term rentals.
Strata pet bylaws can limit or ban pets, except certified guide and service dogs.
